methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Anvil Robotics is a private company in Robotics & Manufacturing founded by Mike Xia. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 peers: 1 public (ticker 277810.KQ) and 8 private companies including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics.

The peer-median method is not applicable. The robotics sector contains 10 same-sector peers, but zero companies share Anvil's stage, zero sit at adjacent development stages, and zero occupy a similar valuation tier. A robust peer-median approach requires a minimum of three comparable datapoints within these narrow filters. Applying a broad sector median would introduce material bias and is therefore rejected.

Without sufficient stage-aligned or tier-aligned peers, triangulation via this method cannot be completed. The analysis faces a structural constraint: the robotics & manufacturing sector, while populated with ten reference companies, lacks clustering around Anvil's particular position in stage and valuation scale. Forward analysis would require either (1) narrowing focus to the identified private peer set (Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics) with full financial and stage disclosure, (2) identifying additional same-stage peers outside the current dataset, or (3) applying alternative methods such as discounted cash flow or venture-capital method if cash flow or capital deployed data becomes available.
